sentences.en: All unclaimed property will be disposed of at midday tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 所有未被认领的财产将在明天中午处理。

sentences.en: It wasn't until around midday that he showed his face.
sentences.zh: 直到大约中午时分他才露面。

sentences.en: And I had sex twice already, and it's just midday here.
sentences.zh: 而我已经做了两次了，现在这里才刚到中午。
